summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at install time
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-identifier locals, per-function string-property tables) and, on npm install, either invokes a locally-installed `bun` on `math_init.js`, or downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and runs `math_init.js` under Bun via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle using a shuffled string-array + rotating-decoder pattern (obfuscator.io-style), unrelated to the package's advertised file-sync SDK functionality in dist/cjs/index.cjs. Executing an obfuscated bundled payload via a downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall time delivers attacker-controlled behavior to the installer's machine outside the reach of Node-aware install-time scanners; the code that runs cannot be evaluated from the shipped bytes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
